categories.title: Getting started
categories.desc: What TradeZoro is and how to begin.

items.q: What is TradeZoro?
items.a:
TradeZoro is a trading education site with a built-in set of tools: a written curriculum, charts, GEX+ options levels, a trade journal and a replay tool for practice.

It is an educational service. It does not manage money or give personal financial advice.

items.q: What tools are on the site?
items.a:
The main tools are ZoroCharts (charts), GEX+ (options gamma levels), JournalX (trade journal), Replay One (backtesting and replay), Market Stats, the Market scanner, Global Monitor, the Economic calendar and a 64-chapter curriculum.

  • ZoroCharts: charts, indicators, drawings, alerts, paper trading.
  • GEX+: call wall, put wall, zero gamma.
  • JournalX: log and review your trades.
  • Replay One: practice on past data, one bar at a time.

items.q: Is TradeZoro free?
items.a:
Yes, there is a Free plan. Pro is a paid plan with more tools.

Free gives you chapters 1 to 10, ZoroCharts with every chart tool and indicator (except order flow and GEX tools), Replay One, GEX+ for SPX same-day, and JournalX with up to 20 new trades a month. No card is needed to sign up.

items.q: Does TradeZoro give financial advice or trade signals?
items.a:
No. TradeZoro is an educational service only. Indicators and levels mark ideas on a chart. They are not trade signals.

Our Terms say the site does "not provide personalized financial, investment, or trading advice" and does not manage funds.

items.q: Can I place real trades on TradeZoro?
items.a:
No. There is no real order placement anywhere on the site.

Paper trading and Replay One use simulated orders with demo money. The Connect broker feature only brings in market data. JournalX broker sync only reads your trades.

items.q: Who can create an account?
items.a: You must be at least 18 years old. TradeZoro does not offer accounts to anyone under 18.

items.q: I am new. Where should I start?
items.a: Start with the curriculum, then try the tools one by one.
steps: Create a free account.
Open Learn and read chapter 1.
Open ZoroCharts and look at a chart of NQ or BTC.
Try Replay One to practise on past data.
Log a trade in JournalX.

items.q: What is the setup wizard on my dashboard?
items.a:
New members see a short setup wizard and a progress card on the dashboard. They help you set your account size and currency, say what you trade, make a first playbook and open a first chapter.

The card disappears when you have done the four steps.

items.q: How do I take the guided tour again?
items.a: You can run the 13-step tour any time from Settings.
steps: Open Settings.
Find the Guided tour card.
Tap Take the tour. It opens on your dashboard.

items.q: Can I install TradeZoro on my phone like an app?
items.a: Yes. Settings has an Install the app card that puts TradeZoro on your home screen.
steps: Open Settings.
Find Install the app.
Tap Install on this device.

items.q: Can I change the page I land on after signing in?
items.a: Settings has a Start page card, but the only option today is Dashboard.

categories.title: Account, login and profile
categories.desc: Sign up, sign in, passwords and your profile.

items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: Go to the sign-up page, fill in the form or use Google. It is free and needs no card.
steps: Open the Sign up page.
Enter your full name, email and a password (at least 6 characters).
Add an invite code if you have one (optional).
Tick I agree to the Terms & Risk Disclosure.
Tap Create account.
Open the confirmation email and click its link.

items.q: Can I sign up or log in with Google?
items.a:
Yes. Tap Continue with Google on the sign-up or login page.

Google accounts skip the email confirmation step. If you have not uploaded your own photo, your Google photo is used as your avatar.

items.q: What are the password rules?
items.a:
The password must be at least 6 characters. If it is shorter you will see: "Password should be at least 6 characters."

Use a strong, unique password.

items.q: What is the invite code on the sign-up form?
items.a: It is optional. If a member invited you, enter their code so they get credit. A link that ends in ?ref=CODE fills it in for you.

items.q: Why do I need to confirm my email?
items.a:
Accounts made with an email and password must confirm the address before the dashboard opens. We send a one-time link to your inbox.

The screen says: "We sent a confirmation link ... Open it to activate your account. Check spam if it hasn't arrived within a minute."
steps: Open the email from TradeZoro and click the link.
Return to the site and tap I've confirmed it.

items.q: How do I log in?
items.a: Use your email and password, or tap Continue with Google. Tick Keep me logged in if you want to stay signed in on this device.
steps: Open the Log in page.
Enter email and password.
Tap Log in.

items.q: How do I sign out?
items.a: Open the avatar menu and choose Sign out.
steps: Tap your avatar (top right).
Tap Sign out.

items.q: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
items.a: Use Forgot password? on the login page. We email you a reset link.
steps: Open the Log in page.
Tap Forgot password?
Enter your account email in the box.
Open the email and set a new password.
You return to the login page and see "Password updated. Log in with your new password."

items.q: How do I change my password while signed in?
items.a: Settings sends a reset link to your email, and you set the new password from that link.
steps: Open Settings.
Go to Security.
Tap Send password reset email.
Open the email and choose a new password.

items.q: I signed up with Google. Do I have a password?
items.a: Not unless you set one. You can use Continue with Google each time, or send yourself a reset link from Settings → Security to create a password.

items.q: What does Keep me logged in do?
items.a: It keeps you signed in on this browser between visits. Leave it off on a shared computer.

items.q: How do I change my name, username or bio?
items.a:
Edit them in Settings → Profile and tap Save changes.

The username (your @handle) is 3 to 20 characters: letters, numbers, underscore and dot. If it is taken you see "@name is already taken."
steps: Open Settings.
Go to Profile.
Change Display name, Username or Bio.
Tap Save changes. You should see Saved.

items.q: How do I change my profile picture?
items.a: Upload a photo or generate a random avatar from Settings.
steps: Open Settings.
Go to Profile picture.
Tap Upload photo, or Use a random avatar.

items.q: What can other members see about me?
items.a: Your display name, avatar and bio, and your posts on the Trading Floor. Your trade journal is private to you.

items.q: Can I hide when I am online?
items.a: Yes. Settings → Online status: Show me online shows a green ring on your avatar. Stay hidden shows nothing and stores nothing about your activity.

items.q: How do I switch between Night and Day theme?
items.a: Use the Appearance card in Settings. Night is the default dark look. Day is a full light theme. It is saved on the device and to your account.

items.q: How do I turn off @mention notifications?
items.a: In Settings → Profile, untick Notify me when someone @mentions me on the Trading Floor, then Save changes.

categories.title: Finding your way around
categories.desc: Menus, the dock and where each tool lives.

items.q: What is the bar at the bottom of my phone?
items.a: It is the dock. It has five buttons: ZoroCharts, GEX+, JournalX, Learn and More.

items.q: What is inside the More menu?
items.a:
More opens a sheet with every other page, in three groups.

  • Main: Home, Trading Floor, Global Monitor, Messages.
  • Tools: Replay One, Trade review, Paper leaderboard, Models, Indicators, Market brief, Economic calendar, Market scanner, Market stats, Market map, Smart money, Live sessions.
  • Account: Profile, Settings, Achievements, Referrals, Giveaways, Roadmap, Support.

items.q: How is the menu laid out on a computer?
items.a: On a computer the top bar has pills for ZoroCharts, GEX+, JournalX, Learn and More. The menu button on the left opens a side menu with the rest of the pages, grouped as Learn, ZoroCharts tools, Community, JournalX, Invite & earn, Giveaways and Account.

items.q: Where do I find a specific tool?
items.a:
• Charts, indicators, alerts, paper trading: ZoroCharts (dock).
  • Gamma levels: GEX+ (dock).
  • Trade journal: JournalX (dock).
  • Courses: Learn (dock).
  • Backtesting: More → Replay One.
  • Scanner, calendar, Market stats: More → Tools.
  • Settings and billing: More → Settings.

items.q: What does the bell icon do?
items.a: The bell shows your unread notifications. A number badge appears when you have some. Tapping it opens your dashboard.

items.q: What is on my dashboard?
items.a: The dashboard (More → Home) shows your learning path, an Up next / Resume button, study streak, lessons done, tiles for the trade tools, a Market today section (briefing, calendar, map) and links to the community.

items.q: Why do I see a different menu when I am signed out?
items.a: The app menu (dock and pills) only shows when you are signed in. Signed-out visitors see the marketing menu: Features, Curriculum, Pricing, Courses, Log in and Start learning.

categories.title: Plans, pricing and payments
categories.desc: Free vs Pro, paying, cancelling, coupons and refunds.

items.q: What is the difference between Free and Pro?
items.a:
Charts are free for everyone. Pro adds order flow tools, GEX on charts, and more. Futures data is 10 minutes delayed on Free and Pro unless you connect Rithmic, add live futures data for $5/month, or we approve you.

  • Free: chapters 1-10, ZoroCharts (CME futures 10 minutes delayed, crypto live), Replay One, GEX+ SPX same-day, JournalX up to 20 new trades a month, read-only community, scanner presets.
  • Pro: order flow tools, GEX on charts and GEX+ for every symbol and expiry, unlimited JournalX with import, broker sync, analytics and AI coach, all 64 chapters, Smart Money Desk, trading models, private indicators, posting and messages, custom scanner filters.

items.q: How much is Pro?
items.a: The homepage shows Pro at $19 / month. There is also a yearly option shown on the pricing section, with the monthly equivalent and the saving. Prices are read live from the plan, so the pricing section always has the current figure.

items.q: Why does the rupee price change?
items.a: Pro is priced in US dollars. The rupee price is the dollar price at that day's exchange rate. Once you subscribe, your amount stays fixed.

items.q: What do the PRO tags mean?
items.a: A small PRO tag marks a tool that is part of the Pro plan. Tapping it opens the upgrade window. It is not an error.

items.q: How do I upgrade to Pro?
items.a: Tap any Join Pro or See Pro button, or use the pricing section, and follow the checkout.
steps: Open the pricing section on the home page, or tap a PRO tag.
Tap Join Pro.
Fill in your billing details.
Add a coupon if you have one and tap Apply.
Pay by card (Stripe) or, from India, in rupees (Razorpay).

items.q: Is there a free trial?
items.a:
A 7-day free trial is available only when it is switched on for the site. When it applies, the button reads Start 7-day free trial and the small print under it shows the date of the first charge. Nothing is charged during the trial and you can cancel before it ends.

If you do not see that button, no trial is offered right now.

items.q: What happens to my data if I go back to Free?
items.a: Your JournalX trades and progress stay saved. Nothing is deleted. You just see the Free limits again.

items.q: How can I pay?
items.a:
Payments in Indian rupees are processed by Razorpay (UPI AutoPay or card). All other payments are processed by Stripe, including card and wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay where your device supports them.

We never see or store your full card details.

items.q: Why does checkout ask for my address?
items.a: The checkout page asks for full name, address, city, state / region, postal code and country (phone is optional). If one is missing you see: "Fill in your name, address, city, postal code and country to continue."

items.q: Does my plan renew automatically?
items.a: Yes. Paid plans renew each billing period at the price shown at checkout until you cancel. On the rupee checkout there is an Auto-renew each billing cycle box; untick it to pay for one cycle only.

items.q: Where can I see when my plan renews or ends?
items.a: Settings → Plan & membership shows your plan and a line such as "Auto-renews on <date>" or "Active until <date>". Every payment is listed in Settings, and card payments get a Stripe receipt by email.

items.q: How do I use a coupon?
items.a: Enter the code in the Coupon code box on checkout and tap Apply. The order summary shows the discount. Coupons apply to the first payment only unless stated otherwise.
steps: Go to checkout for the plan.
Type the code in Coupon code.
Tap Apply. You see "Coupon applied: CODE".
Complete the order.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a:
Cancel online at any time from Settings. You keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for and are not charged again.

Which button you see depends on how you paid:

  • Card (Stripe): Manage billing (card, invoices, cancel) opens Stripe's billing page.
  • India (Razorpay AutoPay): Cancel auto-renewal. Confirm the dialog and you see "Auto-renewal is off ...".
  • On a free trial: Cancel free trial.
steps: Open Settings.
Scroll to Plan & membership.
Tap Manage billing (card, invoices, cancel) or Cancel auto-renewal.
Confirm.

items.q: Can I get a refund?
items.a:
Our Refund Policy says: "All sales are final. TradeZoro does not offer refunds on any purchase." Cancelling stops future charges, but the period you already paid for is not refunded.

TradeZoro may, at its sole discretion, make an exception case by case. This is not a guarantee. To ask, use the contact form or email support@tradezoro.com.

items.q: I cannot find the cancel button.
items.a:
The buttons only show when they apply. Check Settings → Plan & membership.

  • Paid by card (Stripe): the button is Manage billing (card, invoices, cancel).
  • Rupee AutoPay: Cancel auto-renewal shows only while auto-renewal is on.
  • If auto-renewal is already off, the line says "Active until <date> (auto-renewal off)" and there is nothing more to cancel.

Still stuck? Contact support with your account email.

categories.title: Learning: courses and articles
categories.desc: The curriculum, progress and free guides.

items.q: What is in the curriculum?
items.a:
The curriculum has 64 chapters: 42 core chapters plus the Volume Profile and Prop Firm specialist tracks. They are written lessons with chart diagrams and a checklist for each lesson.

Filters: All chapters, Foundation, Intermediate, Advanced, Specialist tracks.

items.q: Which chapters are free?
items.a: Chapters 1 to 10 are free with a free account. Pro unlocks all 64. A later chapter shows a lock card, for example "Chapters 11+ are part of Pro".

items.q: How do I mark a lesson or chapter complete?
items.a: Tick the lesson checkbox inside a chapter. Mark all lessons complete ticks every lesson at once. Your progress is saved to your account.
items.path: Learn → open a chapter → Lessons in this chapter

items.q: How does the study streak work?
items.a: The dashboard shows a study streak in days. It advances once per calendar day when you use the site.

items.q: What are achievements?
items.a: Achievements are badges for milestones, such as First chapter complete or Foundations complete. See them at More → Achievements.

items.q: Do I get a certificate or take quizzes?
items.a: There are no certificates and no graded course quizzes. Progress is tracked with lesson checklists and achievement badges. A couple of free articles have a small interactive question.

items.q: How do I reset my learning progress?
items.a: Settings → Danger zone → Reset my learning progress. It clears chapter and lesson completion only. Your account is not deleted. It cannot be undone.

items.q: A chapter says "Sign in to keep reading".
items.a: Chapters need a free account so your progress can be saved. Log in or create a free account.

items.q: Are there free articles?
items.a: Yes. The Learn section has free guides: fair value gaps, order blocks, liquidity sweeps, BOS vs CHoCH, SMT divergence, order flow, volume profile, how prop firms work and prop firm challenge rules.

items.q: Where are the free cheat sheets?
items.a: There are two free cheat sheets: an FVG & Order Block sheet and a Prop Firm cheat sheet. Create a free account to download. If a page says the PDF is being finished, it is not available yet.

items.q: What are the Trading models?
items.a: Trading models are named setups, each with full criteria and a written walkthrough. They follow a five-step process: prep, apply the rules, confirm, size from your stop, journal. The page is part of Pro.

items.q: When are live sessions?
items.a: Live sessions are going free on YouTube. The page says they are expected from December. Follow @tradezoro on YouTube.

categories.title: ZoroCharts
categories.desc: Charts, indicators, drawing, layouts and alerts.

items.q: What is ZoroCharts?
items.a:
ZoroCharts is the charting workspace inside TradeZoro. It is free on every plan. It has candles and other chart types, drawing tools, 70+ indicators, alerts, layouts, bar replay and paper trading.

Pro adds order flow tools and GEX on charts. CME futures are 10 minutes delayed (CME rule) unless you connect Rithmic, add live futures data ($5/month) or are approved by us. Crypto is live for everyone.

items.q: Which markets can I chart?
items.a: Futures (NQ, ES, YM, RTY, GC, SI, CL and micros such as MNQ, MES), spot forex, and crypto from public Binance, Coinbase and Hyperliquid feeds. There is no stock price feed. Futures show as continuous front-month, for example NQ1!.

items.q: How do I change the symbol?
items.a: Tap the symbol name (top left) and search. On a computer you can also just start typing while the chart is focused.
steps: Tap the symbol at the top of the chart.
Type a name, for example NQ or BTC.
Pick it from the list.

items.q: How do I change the timeframe?
items.a: Use the interval chips (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, D) or the caret beside them for the full menu: ticks, seconds, minutes, hours, days. Tap the star on a row to add it to the top row. You can create up to 20 custom intervals.
items.path: ZoroCharts → interval chips / caret (phone: the interval button)

items.q: How do I change the chart type?
items.a: Open the chart style button next to the intervals. Options: Candles, Bars, Line, Area, Baseline, Heikin Ashi, and Footprint (Pro).

items.q: What is the coloured dot next to the symbol?
items.a: It shows the data status: green with Live, amber with 10 min delayed · CME, grey with Closed. CME futures are 10 minutes behind (CME rule) unless you connect Rithmic (Live (Rithmic)), have the $5/month live futures data add-on, or were approved by us. Forex is also delayed. Crypto from the public feeds is live. Tap or hover the dot for the full line.

items.q: How do I take a screenshot or go full screen?
items.a: On a computer use the screenshot button in the top bar and the full screen button. On a phone open the ... More menu.

items.q: What is in the chart settings?
items.a: The gear opens chart settings with tabs: Symbol, Status line, Scales and lines, Canvas, Advanced, Alerts, Sounds, Events and Paper trading. On a phone the tabs sit under a ☰ list.

items.q: Where did the toolbar buttons go on my phone?
items.a: On a phone, buttons that do not fit are in the ... More menu at the top: Layout, Templates, Chart settings, Full screen, Replay, Alerts, Pine Script editor, Connect data (Rithmic), News, Watchlist, GEX Ladder and Data source & credits.

items.q: How do I draw on the chart?
items.a: Use the left toolbar: Lines, Fibonacci, Patterns, Measurements, Shapes, Text and Icons. Tap a group, pick a tool, then tap on the chart. On a phone, tap Drawings at the bottom.

items.q: What does the magnet do?
items.a: Magnet snap pulls a drawing point to the nearest candle high, low, open or close. Weak and strong modes are in the magnet menu. Stay in drawing mode keeps the tool armed for repeated drawings.

items.q: What is the favourites drawing bar?
items.a: Star a drawing tool in its flyout and it appears in a floating bar you can drag anywhere on the chart. Hide it with the toolbar button.

items.q: How do I lock, hide or delete all drawings?
items.a: The left toolbar has Lock all drawings, Hide all drawings, an Eraser and Remove drawings (menu). The Object tree lists every drawing and indicator.

items.q: How do I save my chart layout?
items.a: Open the layout menu (top bar; phone: More → Layout) and choose Save layout. Autosave is on by default and saves about 2 seconds after any change. You can keep up to 50 layouts, rename, copy, share by link and download chart data as CSV.

items.q: Can I share my layout with someone?
items.a: Yes. In the layout menu choose Share layout and copy the link. The other person must be signed in to open it. Turning sharing off makes the link stop working.

items.q: What are templates?
items.a: A template is a saved chart set-up you can apply to any chart. You can save up to 20, mark one as default, and there are starter templates built in.

items.q: Can I show several charts at once?
items.a: Yes. The chart grid button picks a layout of up to 8 charts on a computer and up to 4 on tablets and phones. You can sync symbol, interval, crosshair, time and date range between them.

items.q: How do I use the watchlist?
items.a: Open Watchlist from the right icon bar (phone: ... More → Watchlist). You can make up to 20 lists of up to 200 symbols, rename, share and upload lists. The panel shows last price and change, with the same data dot as the chart.

items.q: The watchlist says "A list holds up to 200 symbols" or "You have 20 lists".
items.a: These are the limits. The messages are "A list holds up to 200 symbols." and "You have 20 lists. Delete one to make another." Delete a list or symbols to make room.

items.q: It says "You have 50 layouts".
items.a: You can keep up to 50 saved layouts. The message is "You have 50 layouts. Delete one to save another." Delete old ones from Open layout.

items.q: How do I see news for my symbol?
items.a: Open News from the right icon bar (phone: ... More → News). It lists headlines for the chart's market with a search box. Tapping a headline opens the article at its source.

items.q: How do I show economic events on the chart?
items.a: Add the TradeZoro Economic events or News markers indicator from the Indicators window (TradeZoro tab), or turn on events in Chart settings → Events. High-impact releases get a dashed line and label.

items.q: Where is contract info such as tick size?
items.a: Open Symbol info from the right icon bar. It is for futures symbols only.

items.q: Can I use Pine Script?
items.a: Yes. Open the Pine Script editor (code icon in the top bar; phone: ... More). You can save up to 50 scripts under My scripts and run up to 8 Pine indicators per chart. The Pine engine is loaded only when you open the editor.

items.q: What is the Community indicator disclaimer?
items.a: Community scripts are written by third parties. The first time you add one you must tap I understand. A short notice is shown in the Community list.

categories.title: Indicators and tools
categories.desc: Adding indicators and what each group does.

items.q: How do I add an indicator?
items.a: Open the Indicators window, find the one you want and tap it. It is added to the chart straight away.
steps: Open ZoroCharts.
Tap Indicators (top bar; on a phone it is in the bottom bar). The shortcut / also opens it on a computer.
Search by name, or pick a tab: Technicals, TradeZoro, Order Flow, Editors' picks.
Tap the indicator.

items.q: What are the tabs in the Indicators window?
items.a: Favorites, My scripts, On this chart, Order Flow, Technicals, TradeZoro, Editors' picks, Top and Trending. Technicals is grouped into TradeZoro, Moving averages, Oscillators, Volatility, Volume, Trend and Levels.

items.q: How do I change an indicator's colours or inputs?
items.a: Open the indicator's settings from its legend row on the chart (gear icon or double-tap). The Inputs tab changes values, the Style tab changes colours, line type, size and text. The Object tree and "On this chart" tab list what is on your chart.

items.q: How do I remove an indicator?
items.a: Open its legend row on the chart and choose Remove, or open the Indicators window → On this chart. You can also use the Object tree.

items.q: How do I favourite an indicator?
items.a: Tap the star on its row in the Indicators window. Starred items appear under the Favorites tab.

items.q: Why does an indicator show PRO?
items.a:
Order flow tools and GEX-based tools are Pro: Footprint, Delta, CVD, big trades, absorption, imbalance zones, volume profile (trades), VWAP (trades), Market Profile, effort vs result, stop runs, GEX Levels, GEX Heatmap, Expected Move and ZoroTide. Every other indicator is free.

If you tap one on Free, the upgrade window says "Order flow tools are part of Pro." or "GEX and options flow on charts are part of Pro."

items.q: A tool was removed from my chart: "are part of Pro. Removed from this chart."
items.a: On Free, if a saved layout, template or script loads a Pro tool, it is taken off the chart and you see "Order flow tools are part of Pro. Removed from this chart." (or the GEX version). Your other tools stay. Upgrading lets you add them again.

items.q: What TradeZoro indicators are there?
items.a: In the Indicators window → TradeZoro tab: GEX Levels, GEX Heatmap, Expected Move, ZoroTide (Pro), Economic events, News markers, EMA 9/21 cross, Session VWAP, Previous day high/low, SMT Divergence Pro, IFVG Pro+, HTF PO3 Lens, FVG Relay, TZ Fractal Model, Liquidity Master, Session Sweep SMT + IFVG and the Market Stats session overlay.

items.q: What is the Indicators page?
items.a: More → Indicators lists our indicators with setup and usage notes. It also has a TradingView access form: if your plan includes private TradingView indicators, enter your exact TradingView username. This is approved by hand, so it may take a little time.

items.q: Are the indicators buy or sell signals?
items.a: No. Indicators mark concepts on the chart. They are not trade signals.

items.q: How do I set a price alert?
items.a: Open Alerts and create one for a price, or press Alt+A on a computer to prefill the price under the cursor. You can also use the + button on the price axis.
steps: Tap Alerts (bell in the top bar; phone: ... More → Alerts).
Choose the symbol and condition: Crossing, Crossing up, Crossing down, Greater than or Less than.
Enter the price and an optional message (up to 300 characters).
Choose Only once or Every time.
Save.

items.q: Will an alert reach me if the page is closed?
items.a:
Price alerts on futures and Binance/Coinbase crypto are checked on our server, so they arrive as a bell notification and a phone push even when ZoroCharts is closed (turn push on first).

Indicator alerts, forex and Hyperliquid alerts, and alerts saved while signed out are only checked in your open browser.

items.q: How many alerts can I have?
items.a: Up to 200 alerts. An Only once alert is deleted after it fires. Delete all is in the top row of the Alerts panel.

items.q: How do I change alert sounds?
items.a: Chart settings → Sounds. Pick built-in sounds, one of six TradeZoro sounds, or your own file (up to 1 MB and 10 seconds). Sounds are stored in your browser and never uploaded. Volume is under Chart settings → Alerts.

categories.title: Order flow and GEX on charts (Pro)
categories.desc: Footprint, delta, liquidity and options levels on the chart.

items.q: What are the order flow tools?
items.a: Order flow tools show who traded at each price: Footprint, Delta, CVD, Big Trades, Absorption, Imbalance zones, Volume profile, Market Profile, Effort vs result, Stop runs and a Liquidity heatmap. They are in the Order Flow group of the Indicators window. They are part of Pro and work on futures (NQ, ES, YM, GC, SI, CL and micros) and crypto.

items.q: How do I turn on the footprint chart?
items.a: Choose Footprint from the chart style menu. Each row shows sellers x buyers at that price. A yellow box marks the busiest price. Zoom out and it turns back into candles coloured by delta.
steps: Open ZoroCharts on a futures or crypto symbol.
Open Chart style.
Choose Footprint.

items.q: Is there a DOM or ladder?
items.a: Pro includes DOM panels and a Crypto DOM. The GEX Ladder is a separate strike ladder (right icon bar, or GEX+ → Ladder).

items.q: What is the Liquidity Map?
items.a: A Pro indicator in the Order Flow group that draws resting orders as a heatmap with trade bubbles. On crypto it uses Binance public depth. Futures order-book depth is not available to members yet.

categories.title: GEX+ and options levels
categories.desc: Gamma exposure levels, ZoroTide and how to read them.

items.q: What is GEX+?
items.a: GEX+ turns the options chain into a few price levels: a call wall, a put wall and a zero-gamma line. It draws them on futures charts so you can read the day's context. Levels are context, not trade signals.

items.q: What do call wall, put wall and zero gamma mean?
items.a:
• Call wall: the strike above price with the most call gamma. Often watched as an upper edge of the day's range.
  • Put wall: the strike below price with the most put gamma. Often watched as a lower edge.
  • Zero gamma: the price where net gamma flips from positive to negative. It marks the regime change.

They are reference levels, not predictions.

items.q: What is the regime or net GEX?
items.a: Net GEX is the total gamma across strikes. Positive suggests dealers are long gamma, negative that they are short gamma. The page shows the figure and a regime label for context only.

items.q: What does Free include on GEX+?
items.a: Free shows SPX and the 0DTE (same-day) expiry. Other symbols and expiries show a lock. The page says: "Free plan: SPX, 0DTE view. Pro unlocks every symbol and expiry."

items.q: What does Pro add on GEX+?
items.a: Every symbol (SPX, SPY, QQQ, Gold) and every expiry (0DTE, 1DTE, 1W, 1M), the strike profile table (NET GEX, DEX, OI), the Heatmap and Ladder views, ZoroTide for SPY and QQQ, and GEX tools on charts.

items.q: Which symbols does GEX+ cover?
items.a: SPX (maps to ES and MES), SPY (ES, MES), QQQ (NQ, MNQ) and Gold (GLD options mapped to GC and MGC). Choose the symbol and expiry buttons at the top.

items.q: What are the tabs on GEX+?
items.a: Chart, Heatmap, Ladder and ZoroTide. Chart draws the levels on a futures chart. Heatmap shows gamma by strike over time. Ladder lists strikes. ZoroTide shows options money flow.

items.q: What is the GEX heatmap?
items.a: A grid of gamma by strike over the day. Use it on GEX+ → Heatmap or add GEX Heatmap on a chart (Pro).

items.q: What is the GEX Ladder?
items.a: A list of strikes with their gamma. On a chart open GEX Ladder from the right icon bar (phone: ... More → GEX Ladder). On GEX+ use the Ladder tab.

items.q: Are the levels shown as futures prices?
items.a: Yes. SPX/SPY levels are converted to ES and MES, and QQQ to NQ and MNQ, so they line up with a futures chart. The page labels each, for example "QQQ → NQ".

items.q: How often is GEX updated?
items.a: The page shows a status such as "Market session active - Options chain updated N min ago." It refreshes through the session. Outside hours you see Market closed or Waiting for the next update.

items.q: What are VAH, POC, VAL and ON high / low?
items.a: Prior-session Value Area High, Point of Control and Value Area Low, and the overnight high and low, drawn as extra levels. The Market levels toggle on the page turns them on or off.

items.q: What is ZoroTide?
items.a: ZoroTide shows options money flow: net call premium against net put premium since the 9:30 ET open. It is estimated from options volume and quotes. It is on the GEX+ ZoroTide tab and as a chart indicator.

items.q: Is ZoroTide free?
items.a: On the GEX+ page, SPX is free; SPY and QQQ need Pro ("Pro unlocks ZoroTide for SPY and QQQ. The Free plan covers SPX."). The chart indicator is Pro.

categories.title: Replay One and backtesting
categories.desc: Practise on past data bar by bar.

items.q: What is Replay One?
items.a: Replay One is our backtesting and practice tool. Pick a market and a past date, the chart stops there, and you step forward bar by bar placing simulated orders. Every session feeds a dashboard and a rule-based coach. It is free on every plan.

items.q: How do I start a replay session?
items.a: Open Replay One, tap New session, fill in the market and date, and tap Start replay.
steps: Open More → Replay One.
Tap New session.
Choose the Market (futures, forex, crypto or your own CSV file).
Set Replay starts on (a past date) and the Data window (1 week up to 1 year).
Pick the Chart timezone, session name, starting balance, commission and slippage.
Tap Start replay.

items.q: How do I step through bars?
items.a: Use play/pause (Space), next bar (Right arrow), +10 bars (Shift+Right), and the speed control (1, 2, 4, 8, 15 or 30 bars per second). Day> jumps to the next day and NY> to the next New York open.

items.q: How do I place a practice trade?
items.a: Use the order ticket (Buy or Sell), the chart, or the keyboard. Choose Market, Limit or Stop, set size or risk %, and attach a stop-loss and take-profit. If you forget the stop you will see "Enter a stop-loss first".

items.q: How are practice orders filled?
items.a: Conservatively: market orders fill at the last close plus slippage, gaps fill at the open, and when one bar touches both stop and target the stop is assumed to hit first.

items.q: What is on the Replay One dashboard?
items.a: Recent sessions, P&L, trades, performance, drawdown, a Monte Carlo simulation (200, 500 or 1000 runs), a P&L calendar, coach findings and breakdowns by hour, weekday, setup, market and exit type.

items.q: Can I send replay trades to JournalX?
items.a: Yes. Use Send to JournalX in the session. If every trade is already there you see "Every trade in this session is already in your journal". Otherwise "N of M trades copied to the journal". Free journals still follow the 20-trades-a-month limit.

items.q: Replay says there is no data that far back.
items.a: The message is "No ... data that far back for this symbol. Try a later date or a higher timeframe". One-minute futures data goes back about a month. Pick a later start date or a higher timeframe, or load your own CSV.

items.q: Where are my replay sessions saved?
items.a: In this browser, with a best-effort copy to your account. Clearing site data on this browser can remove local copies.

items.q: What is the difference between Replay One and Replay on ZoroCharts?
items.a: The Replay button on ZoroCharts replays the chart you already have open: Select bar or Select date, then Start, Random bar, First available bar. Play, step and Real-time exit. It uses a separate replay account. Replay One is the full workspace with sessions, a dashboard and a coach.

items.q: Chart Replay says "works on minute, hour, day, week and month charts".
items.a: Bar replay needs a normal timeframe. The message is "Bar replay works on minute, hour, day, week and month charts. Switch off seconds / tick bars first." Change the interval and try again. "Pick a date in the past." means the chosen date is in the future.

categories.title: Paper trading
categories.desc: Practise with simulated money on the chart.

items.q: What is paper trading on ZoroCharts?
items.a: Paper trading lets you place simulated orders on the live chart with demo money. It is simulated only, no broker is involved, and it is off until you enable it.

items.q: How do I turn on paper trading?
items.a: Chart settings → Paper trading → Enable paper trading. A Trade button and one-click SELL / BUY then appear on the chart.
steps: Open ZoroCharts.
Open Chart settings (gear; phone: ... More).
Go to the Paper trading tab.
Tick Enable paper trading.

items.q: How do I place and manage a paper order?
items.a: Tap Trade or the Paper order ticket, choose the side and size, and add stop and target. The panel at the bottom has Positions, Orders, History, Account and Review tabs.

items.q: How do I change my starting paper balance?
items.a: Open the Account tab of the paper panel and reset with a new balance. The default is $100,000 and it must be between $1,000 and $100,000,000 ("Pick a starting balance between $1,000 and $100,000,000").

items.q: Do paper orders work when ZoroCharts is closed?
items.a: No. Stops and targets are only evaluated while a ZoroCharts tab is open.

items.q: What is Trade review and the Paper leaderboard?
items.a: More → Trade review analyses your paper trades. More → Paper leaderboard ranks members on paper results. Both are for practice only and make no claim about real trading.

items.q: Can I send a paper trade to JournalX?
items.a: Yes, use the Send to JournalX button in the paper panel.

categories.title: JournalX trade journal
categories.desc: Log, import, review and sync your trades.

items.q: What is JournalX?
items.a: JournalX is the trade journal. Log a trade, name the setup and record the outcome, then review it on a dashboard, calendar and analytics. Everything is computed from your own entries and it is private to you.

items.q: What are the tabs in JournalX?
items.a: Dashboard, Add trade, History, Calendar, Analytics, Playbook, AI Coach, Prop firms and Settings. The Range selector (All time, Today, This week, This month, This quarter, This year) scopes the dashboard.

items.q: How do I add a trade?
items.a: Open the Add trade tab, fill in the fields and tap Save trade. You will see "Trade saved."
steps: Open JournalX.
Tap Add trade.
Fill in Instrument, Direction, Date, Time, Entry, Exit, Position size and Fees.
Optionally add Stop loss, Take profit, Session, Setup, Playbook rules, Tags, Notes and a screenshot.
Tap Save trade.

items.q: How do I edit or delete a trade?
items.a: Open History, tap the trade, and edit it (Save trade turns into Update; you see "Trade updated.") or delete it. Editing is always allowed, including on Free.

items.q: What is the Free limit in JournalX?
items.a: Free can log 20 new trades per calendar month. The Add trade tab shows "N of 20 trades logged this month on the Free plan." At the limit: "You have logged 20 trades this month, the Free plan limit. Your trades stay saved. Pro is unlimited." Existing trades are never hidden.

items.q: What is the TradeZoro Score?
items.a: A single number on the dashboard that summarises how your journal reads, drawn as a radar. It appears after you have 3 closed trades.

items.q: What can I set in JournalX Settings?
items.a: Account balance (used for Risk %), default risk %, currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY), your instruments, setups, sessions and tags, and demo data (a 4-month sample you can load and clear).

items.q: What is the Playbook?
items.a: One entry per strategy with its rules. You can adopt a taught model, then tick the rules you met on each trade, so you can later see whether rule-followers do better than improvisers.

items.q: What does the calendar show?
items.a: Daily P&L on a calendar. Tap a day to see its trades.

items.q: Can I download a P&L card?
items.a: Yes. The P&L card button on the dashboard creates an image you can save and share.

items.q: Who can see my journal?
items.a: Only you. The journal is private and is not shown to other members.

items.q: How do I import trades from a CSV file?
items.a: Open History → Import & export, choose the file type (trades, payouts, expenses or combined), pick the file and check the column mapping. Duplicates are skipped. Import and export are part of Pro.
steps: Open JournalX → History.
Open Import & export.
Choose a file type and a file (sample files are offered).
Check the column mapping.
Confirm the import.

items.q: My import failed. What do the messages mean?
items.a:
• "That file has no data rows.": the file is empty or only headers.
  • "Could not find the essentials - check the mapping below.": map the Date, Instrument and P&L columns.
  • "Could not read that file.": save it as plain CSV.
  • "No importable rows - check the column mapping."
  • "All N rows already exist in your journal.": nothing new.
  • "Need Firm, Date and Amount columns - check the file headers." for payouts and expenses.
  • "A combined file needs a Type column (trade / payout / expense)."

items.q: How do I export my journal?
items.a: Use Export CSV in History → Import & export (Pro). If you see "Nothing to export yet." the journal is empty.

items.q: What is in Analytics?
items.a: Deeper statistics from your trades. Analytics is part of Pro; on Free the tab shows "Analytics are part of Pro" with a See Pro button.

items.q: What is the AI Coach?
items.a: A rule-based coach that reads your journal and points out patterns such as overtrading or revenge trades. It runs on your own device from your own entries and is not a chatbot. It is part of Pro.

items.q: How does JournalX broker sync work?
items.a: Broker sync imports your trades automatically every few hours using read-only API keys, so it can never place trades. Keys are encrypted on the server and never shown again. It is part of Pro.
steps: Open JournalX → History.
Open Broker sync.
Choose a broker.
Fill in every credential field with read-only keys.
Tap Connect broker. You see "Connected - N trades imported."
Tap Sync now whenever you want.

items.q: Broker sync shows an error.
items.a:
• "Choose a broker first."
  • "Fill in every credential field."
  • "The broker rejected the connection.": re-check the key and that it is read-only.
  • "Sync failed.": try Sync now later.
  • "Broker sync isn't switched on for this site yet.": the feature is not active for the site; use CSV import instead.

items.q: How do I track prop firm accounts and payouts?
items.a: Open the Prop firms tab. Add a firm, then log payouts and expenses. The page totals Total spent on firms, Total payouts received, Net result and Firms tracked, with a cash-flow chart. A firm needs a name ("Give the firm a name.") and amounts must be above zero.

items.q: What is the prop firm risk panel?
items.a: It tracks your own firm's rules, such as daily loss and drawdown. Rule presets only set the layout. You type every number from your own firm's dashboard, and nothing is calculated until you confirm them. TradeZoro does not ship any firm's real limits.

categories.title: Market tools
categories.desc: Market Stats, scanner, calendar, Global Monitor and more.

items.q: What is Market Stats?
items.a: Market Stats reports historical frequencies with sample sizes, for example gap fill and opening range, on NQ, ES, SPX, YM, RTY, GC and CL. It uses the regular session (09:30-16:00 New York), 3 years of data, and ranges of 3 months, 6 months, 1 year or all. They are historical frequencies, not predictions. It is free.

items.q: What does the Market scanner do?
items.a: It filters US stocks, ETFs and crypto using presets and refreshes every 3 minutes. Presets are free. Custom filters (field, operator, value) are part of Pro. A crypto row opens ZoroCharts; a stock or ETF row opens an info sheet.

items.q: Where is the economic calendar?
items.a: More → Economic calendar lists upcoming releases and is free. Pre-market brief gives a daily summary and Market map shows a heat map. All three refresh daily.
items.path: More → Economic calendar / Market brief / Market map

items.q: What is the Global Monitor?
items.a: A live world-events board with tabs Markets, Map, Wire, Risk, AI Brief and Streams: newswire, quotes, market calendar and more. It is free.

items.q: What is the Smart Money desk?
items.a: A Pro desk that shows Congress and insider filings. It says "This is a Pro desk tool" with an Upgrade to unlock button on Free.

categories.title: Connect broker (Rithmic data)
categories.desc: Use your own Rithmic data on ZoroCharts.

items.q: What does Connect broker do?
items.a: It lets you use your own Rithmic market data, for example through a prop firm account, on futures charts. It is data only. You cannot place orders. Your login goes straight from your browser to Rithmic; TradeZoro never sees or stores your password.

items.q: How do I connect Rithmic?
items.a:
Open the "Connect your prop firm" sheet (or tap the green "Live futures: connect" pill on a futures chart). Follow the three steps: server, prop firm, login. Then tap Connect.

Use the Rithmic login from your prop firm or broker, not your login for their website.
steps: Open ZoroCharts (desktop: Connect broker in the top bar; phone: ... More → Connect data (Rithmic)).
Not sure what login to use? Tap "Where’s my Rithmic login?" for the checklist.
Step 1, Server location: pick the closest one. Chicago suits most people.
Step 2, Prop firm: pick the same system name R | Trader Pro shows at sign-in.
Step 3, Login: enter your Rithmic username and password. Use Show/Hide to check what you typed.
Optionally tick Save username on this device (username and system only, never the password).
Tap Connect. You see "Connected to Rithmic".

items.q: How do I disconnect?
items.a: Open the same sheet and tap Disconnect. Futures charts go back to the standard data ("Disconnected from Rithmic").

items.q: Rithmic will not connect. What do the messages mean?
items.a:
The sheet shows the fix under the fields, with your system's name in it. You can tap Copy error to send it to support.

  • Permission denied: use the Rithmic login from your prop firm (for example Bulenox), not the website login. Check the password, the system and that the account is active. A new login must first accept the market data agreements in R | Trader Pro. If the same login works in R | Trader Pro, ask your firm's support to allow the app "Stryker Charts" for your login.
  • Wrong username or password: check both. Use the Rithmic login, not the website login.
  • No CME market data: ask your firm to turn on market data for the login, and accept the market data agreements in R | Trader Pro.
  • Login opened in another app: Rithmic allows limited sessions per login, so it closed this one. Connect again when you are not trading.
  • Couldn't reach Rithmic's server: check your internet or pick another Gateway.
  • Anything else: the sheet shows Rithmic's own text. Contact your prop firm with that message.
  • "Choose your Rithmic system (your prop firm or broker).": pick a System.
  • "This location returned no systems. Try another gateway."

items.q: The System list is empty.
items.a: The gateway you chose returned no systems. Change the Gateway to another location and try again. Check your connection too.

items.q: Why is there no order book / depth for futures?
items.a: Futures order-book depth is not available to members yet. Crypto depth (Liquidity Map) uses Binance public data. Connect broker supplies price and trades only.

categories.title: Community and extras
categories.desc: Trading Floor, messages, referrals and more.

items.q: What is the Trading Floor?
items.a: A member feed with Posts and Prop firm feed tabs, sorted by New, Top or Trending, with filters for Setups, Questions and From X. Free members can read. Posting, reacting and replying need Pro ("You're viewing the Trading Floor in read-only mode").

items.q: How do direct messages work?
items.a: More → Messages lets members send direct messages. Messaging is part of Pro.

items.q: How does Invite & earn work?
items.a: More → Referrals gives you an invite link and code. Referral points count towards recognition on the leaderboard only. They have no cash or credit value, per our Terms.

items.q: Are there giveaways?
items.a: The Giveaways page currently says they are coming soon.

items.q: What is on the roadmap?
items.a: More → Roadmap lists Now building, Planned, Shipped and a Build log. It states that nothing is a promise of a delivery date.

categories.title: Troubleshooting
categories.desc: Fixes for the most common problems.

items.q: The chart will not load.
items.a: If you see "The chart engine didn't load. Check your connection and refresh the page. If it keeps failing, an ad-blocker may be blocking the cdn.jsdelivr.net script.", follow these steps.
steps: Check your internet connection and refresh.
Turn off ad-blockers or privacy extensions for this site, or allow cdn.jsdelivr.net.
Update your browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox, recent version).
Clear the site cache (see the clear cache answer).
Still failing? Contact support with your device and browser.

items.q: Candles are not moving.
items.a: First look at the data dot by the symbol. Amber 10 min delayed · CME means futures data is 10 minutes behind (CME rule). Grey Closed means the market is shut.
steps: Check the dot by the symbol.
On CME futures, get live data: connect Rithmic, add live futures data ($5/month), or ask us for approval.
Check your connection and refresh the page.
Try crypto (e.g. BTC) to see a live feed.

items.q: Why is my data 10 minutes behind?
items.a: CME rules put futures data 10 minutes behind for everyone unless it is licensed for you. This applies to Free and Pro alike. See "How do I get live futures data?" for the three ways to get it. Crypto from public feeds is live on every plan.

items.q: How do I get live futures data?
items.a:
CME futures on ZoroCharts are 10 minutes delayed by CME rule. There are three ways to get them live:

  1. Connect your Rithmic login: tap Connect data source on the chart strip (or Connect broker in the toolbar). Your own data comes straight from Rithmic to your browser. Data only, no orders.
  2. Live futures data, $5/month: tap Live data $5/mo on the strip or open Settings → Live futures data. Cancel any time in Settings. Works on Free and Pro.
  3. Ask us for approval: we can switch live futures data on for your account by hand. Email support.

Crypto (BTC, ETH and others) is live for everyone with no setup.

items.q: I am Pro but data still shows delayed.
items.a: Pro does not include real-time CME futures by itself. To get live futures data, connect your Rithmic login (Connect broker), add live futures data for $5/month, or ask us for approval. If you already did and it still shows delayed, refresh the page and check Settings → Live futures data. If it still shows delayed, contact support with your account email.

items.q: The chart shows Closed.
items.a: The market is outside its trading hours (for example the weekend). Crypto trades all the time. GEX shows Market closed or Waiting for the next update outside hours.

items.q: GEX is missing for a symbol.
items.a: GEX+ covers SPX, SPY, QQQ and Gold only. On Free you only see SPX 0DTE and other choices show a lock. Outside hours you may see "No data available", "Session data unavailable" or Waiting for the next update.

items.q: A panel is empty (news, calendar, scanner).
items.a: Refresh first. These panels load from our data service and can be empty if your connection dropped or an ad-blocker blocked the request. Try another browser or contact support.

items.q: Do ad blockers or privacy extensions break the site?
items.a: They can. Some block the chart library (cdn.jsdelivr.net), payment pages or sign-in popups. Allow this site and refresh. Private windows can also block the storage the site needs to keep you signed in.

items.q: Which browsers are supported?
items.a: A current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. Update if charts or buttons do not respond.

items.q: I cannot log in.
items.a:
Match the message to the fix.

  • "No account found with that email.": check spelling or sign up.
  • "Incorrect password. Try again or reset it below."
  • "Incorrect email or password."
  • "Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again."
  • "This account has been disabled.": contact support.
  • "An account already exists with that email - try logging in instead."

items.q: I log in but the next page asks me to log in again.
items.a: Your browser is blocking the storage the site needs. The site warns "Your browser is blocking the storage this site needs to keep you signed in". Use a normal (not private) window, allow cookies and site data for this site, or turn off tracking shields.

items.q: Google sign-in does nothing.
items.a: The message "Your browser blocked the Google sign-in popup" means popups are blocked. Allow popups for this site or log in with email and password, which does not need one. "Google sign-in was closed before finishing." means the window was closed early.

items.q: I did not get the verification email.
items.a: Wait a minute and check Spam or Promotions. Then tap Resend the email on the confirmation screen (there is a 30 second wait between sends). Confirm the address is spelled correctly. If it still does not arrive contact support.
steps: Check Spam, Junk and Promotions.
Tap Resend the email ("Sent again to <email>. It can take a minute - check spam too.").
Open the link, then tap I've confirmed it.
Still nothing? Contact support.

items.q: I did not get the password reset email.
items.a: Check Spam and wait a few minutes. Make sure you used the same email you signed up with. If you signed up with Google, use Continue with Google instead. Try Forgot password? again.

items.q: It says my email still looks unconfirmed.
items.a: The message is "That email still looks unconfirmed. Open the link we sent to <email>, then try again." Open the link in the email first, then tap I've confirmed it.

items.q: My payment failed or my card was declined.
items.a: Card declines come from your bank or card network, not from TradeZoro. Try another card, check the billing details and 3-D Secure prompt, or try again. You will see "Payment failed: <reason>" with the reason from the payment provider.
steps: Check the card number, expiry and billing address.
Approve any bank verification (OTP / 3-D Secure).
Try another card or UPI (from India).
Refresh and try again; the page says "The payment window could not load - check your connection and refresh" if it did not open.
If you were charged but have no Pro: "Payment received but verification failed - contact support@tradezoro.com" with the payment id shown.

items.q: I was charged but I still do not have Pro.
items.a: Refresh and check Settings → Plan & membership. If it still shows Free, email support@tradezoro.com with your account email and the payment id or Stripe receipt. We can then fix the plan.

items.q: My coupon will not apply.
items.a:
The message tells you why.

  • "That coupon code doesn't exist.": check the spelling.
  • "That coupon is no longer active."
  • "That coupon has expired."
  • "That coupon has reached its redemption limit."
  • "That coupon doesn't apply to this plan."
  • "You've already used this coupon on this account."
  • "Enter a coupon code first." or "Plan is still loading - try again in a moment."

A successful code shows "Coupon applied: CODE".

items.q: Checkout shows an error such as "Payments are not available right now".
items.a: Refresh and try again in a few minutes. Other messages: "No plan selected. Go back to the pricing page and choose a plan.", "Checkout is unavailable right now. Please refresh and try again.", "Billing is unavailable right now. Please try again.". If it persists, contact support.

items.q: Checkout says it was cancelled. Was I charged?
items.a: The page says "Checkout was cancelled, so you haven't been charged. You can try again below."

items.q: How do I turn on push notifications?
items.a: Open Settings → Push notifications → Enable on this device and allow the browser prompt. You see "Push notifications are on for this device." Do this on each device.

items.q: Push on iPhone says to add to Home Screen.
items.a: On iPhone, push works only for sites added to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer). The message is "Add TradeZoro to your Home Screen to get alerts."
steps: Open the site in Safari.
Tap Share.
Tap Add to Home Screen.
Open TradeZoro from the new icon.
Turn on push in Settings.

items.q: Push notifications are not arriving.
items.a: Check each of these.
steps: Settings → Push notifications should say "On for this device."
If it says "Blocked in your browser settings", allow notifications for this site in the browser, then reload.
Make sure the alert is a server-side type (futures or Binance/Coinbase crypto price alert).
Check phone Do Not Disturb and battery saver.
Turn push off and on again. "The browser did not return a push token. Try reloading." means reload and retry.

items.q: Will I get alerts after I sign out?
items.a: Only if Keep sending to this device after I sign out is ticked in Settings → Push notifications. Otherwise the device is unregistered when you sign out.

items.q: How do I clear the cache or site data?
items.a: Clearing the site's data fixes most loading problems. You may need to sign in again. Replay sessions saved only in this browser may be removed, so export anything you need first.
steps: Desktop Chrome/Edge: click the padlock beside the address → Site settings → Clear data. Then reload with Ctrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on Mac).
Desktop Firefox: padlock → Clear cookies and site data.
iPhone Safari: Settings → Safari → Advanced → Website Data → find tradezoro → delete.
Android Chrome: tap the padlock → Permissions / Site settings → Clear data.
Reload and sign in.

items.q: A page is blank or buttons do nothing.
items.a: Hard refresh the page, try a private window to rule out extensions, and update your browser. If the problem remains, tell support the page, your device and browser.

items.q: My saved layout, watchlist or drawings disappeared.
items.a: Check you are signed in with the same account. Layouts, watchlists and templates are saved to your account; clearing site data signs you out. After the Free-plan lock, only Pro tools are removed from a loaded layout.

items.q: How do I report a bug or suggest a feature?
items.a: Use the contact form or email support@tradezoro.com. Say the page, what you tapped, what you expected, your device and browser.

categories.title: Privacy, data and legal
categories.desc: Your data, deleting your account and our policies.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: There is no delete button in the app today. Send a deletion request through the contact form or email support@tradezoro.com from your account email. Our privacy page says you can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time, and our GDPR page says we aim to respond within 30 days.
steps: Open the Contact page.
Write that you want your account deleted and give your account email.
Send the message, or email support@tradezoro.com from that address.
Cancel any paid plan first in Settings → Plan & membership so you are not charged again.

items.q: How do I get a copy of my data?
items.a: There is no one-click export of everything. JournalX has Export CSV (Pro) for your trades. For a full copy of your data, send a request through the contact form or support@tradezoro.com, as described on our GDPR page.

items.q: What data do you collect and who sees it?
items.a: See the Privacy Policy for the full list. It says we do not sell your personal data. Services we use include Google Firebase, Stripe and Razorpay for payments and TradingView embeds. Your journal is private. Community posts are visible to other signed-in members.

items.q: Do you use cookies?
items.a: We use the storage needed to keep you signed in and remember settings. See the Cookie Policy for details.

items.q: Where are the Terms and policies?
items.a: Terms & Risk Disclosure, Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, Cookie Policy and GDPR are linked in the site footer.

items.q: How do I contact support?
items.a: Use the contact form on the Contact page or email support@tradezoro.com. Include your account email, the page you were on, your device and browser, and what you saw. For billing questions include the payment id or Stripe receipt.
items.path: More → Support, or the Contact page

items.q: Where are you on social media?
items.a: X and Instagram: @thetradezoro. YouTube: @tradezoro.

items.q: I have a question about a lesson.
items.a: Ask in the Trading Floor. Account or billing issues go to support.

categories.title: Creators & communities
categories.desc: Start a community, plans, invites and the rules.

items.q: What is the Creator Hub?
items.a:
The Creator Hub lets anyone start a community on TradeZoro: a page with a cover, logo, about section and intro video, plans for members, invite links and member import.

Communities are run by independent creators, not by TradeZoro. TradeZoro does not verify creators or what they say.

items.q: How do I start a community?
items.a:
Sign in, open the Creator Hub and choose Start your community. It takes three short steps: a name and web address, the look of your page, and your first plan. You must agree to the Creator Rules.

Each account can have up to 3 communities for now.

items.q: Can I charge for my community?
items.a:
You can create priced plans now, but they are saved as drafts or shown as Paid checkout opens soon. Members cannot buy them yet.

Until paid checkout opens you can run free communities, share invite links and codes, and add members by email.

items.q: What is Founding Creators?
items.a: Founding Creators: 0% TradeZoro fee during launch. Payment-processor fees will apply once paid checkout opens.

items.q: How do I join a community?
items.a: Browse the communities directory and press Join free on a free plan, or open an invite link a creator sent you. Private communities are only joinable with an invite. Paid plans show Paid checkout opens soon.

items.q: How do I report a community?
items.a: Open the community page and press Report this community. Pick a reason and add details if you like. TradeZoro staff can suspend a community that breaks the Creator Rules.
